doc.title: Grover Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, February 13, 1996

title: Basie's silent discipline
summary: Basie would let a late or unwarmed player fail on a tough solo and say only that it was his job.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Yeah. You’re messing it up you know, and he’s sitting over there. And if you say anything he’d say, “well that’s your job, that’s your solo.”
Lot to be learned from that.
That’s right. Oh he was something else. He was great though.
